protocol.PWT_comparison: strict error < threshold in native pixels; this is not the official TAP-Vid score
protocol.direction_motion_threshold: GT and predicted displacement >1 native pixel per 0.2 s; nonmoving predictions reduce direction coverage
protocol.rigidity: pair-distance drift from each method own initial 3D constellation; a consistency diagnostic, not ground-truth 3D accuracy

conditional_3D_est.reference: same native future sensor Z and tracker pixels, reexpressed with the method candidate K; not calibrated 3D ground truth
